subject.title: Track OpenClaw seams needed for full imported-plugin parity

question: Should Babelfish retain this umbrella tracker while maintainers sponsor separate upstream OpenClaw API designs for each requested seam?
rationale: The work changes permanent public plugin contracts and divides lifecycle, policy, authentication, and marketplace ownership between repositories; those boundaries cannot be selected safely by automated implementation.

options.title: Split into upstream designs
options.body: Keep this tracker and create or link one narrowly scoped OpenClaw design item per seam, each with an owner and security contract.

options.title: Prioritize selected seams
options.body: Choose only the highest-value seams for public APIs now and explicitly defer the others in the Babelfish support matrix.

options.title: Keep unsupported
options.body: Decline new host APIs for now and document the affected imported contributions as intentionally unsupported rather than approximate them.

recommendation.title: Split into upstream designs
recommendation.body: Keep this tracker and create or link one narrowly scoped OpenClaw design item per seam, each with an owner and security contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the architectural breakdown and are the strongest available owner for coordinating Babelfish requirements with upstream API owners.
